-- CETAS using openrowset 

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'enriched_files',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    OPENROWSET
    (
        BULK 'raw_files',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
 AS Query1; 

 -- cetas using views

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_cetas_view
WITH(
    LOCATION = 'enriched_files_view',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT 
    *
FROM revenue_view

-- SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas_view

-- COPY INTO
DROP TABLE copy_into_table
CREATE TABLE copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)

-- Loading data from a file into copy_into_table

COPY INTO copy_into_table
(
    Dealer_ID 1,
    Model_ID 2,
    Branch_ID 3,
    Date_ID 4,
    Units_Sold 5,
    Revenue 6
)
FROM 'https://storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/enriched/enriched_files/'
WITH
(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity')

)

SELECT * FROM copy_into_table

ALTER DATABASE noorserverless
COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8;

SELECT DATABASEPROPERTYEX('noorserverless', 'Collation') AS DatabaseCollation;

-- VIEWS

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS revenue_view;
CREATE VIEW revenue_view
AS
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    OPENROWSET
    (
        BULK 'raw_files',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
        FORMAT = 'CSV' ,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    )
 AS Query1; 

-- SELECT * FROM revenue_view

-- Creating Master Key
-- CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = ''

-- Create Credential
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL noorcreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with raw container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with enriched container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE enriched_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://enriched@storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- Creating external file format parquet
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)

--Round Robin Table
CREATE TABLE round_table
(
    id INT,
    name VARCHAR(4000),
    salary INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN

)

INSERT INTO round_table
VALUES
(1,'aa',10);

SELECT * FROM round_table

-- Replicate Table
CREATE SCHEMA gold;

CREATE TABLE gold.dim_product
(
    dim_prod_key INT,
    prod_id INT,
    prod_name VARCHAR(4000)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
)

-- Hash Distribution 
CREATE TABLE gold.fact_table
(
    dim_key_prod INT,
    revenue INT,
    cost INT
)
WITH 
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(dim_key_prod)
)

-- Creating Master Key
-- CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = ''

-- Create Credential
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL noorcreds
WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with raw container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- CREATING EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE with enriched container

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE enriched_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://storagesynapselearning.dfs.core.windows.net/enriched/',
    CREDENTIAL = noorcreds
)

-- Creating external file format csv

-- DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS(
                        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
                        FIRST_ROW = 2,
                        ENCODING = 'UTF8'

                )
)

-- Creating external file format parquet
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)

-- CREATING EXTERNAL TABLE 
-- DROP EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE revenue_ext_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold VARCHAR(4000),
    Revenue VARCHAR(4000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'raw_files',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = csv_format
)

SELECT * FROM revenue_ext_table

-- Reading Data From the File 
-- OPENROWSET FUNCTION (to apply sql on top of data sitting in the data lake)
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    OPENROWSET
    (
        BULK 'raw_files',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE
    ) AS Query1

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE parquet_table
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'enriched_files',
    DATA_SOURCE = enriched_ext_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format

)

WITH(

)
AS 
SELECT * FROM parquet_table
